The respondent No.1/SLAO, Bangalore Development Authority, Bangalore has made this reference under Sections 30 and 31(2) of Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (hereinafter referred as 'L.A.C Act' for short) for apportionment of compensation amount.

2. The breif facts of the case is that land bearing Sy.No.24/2 measuring 2 acres and 24 guntas situated at Sonnehalli village, Kengeri Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluka has been acquired for the purpose of Sir M Vishweshwaraiah Nagara layout.
Preliminary notification has been published on 24-01-2002 and final notification has been published on 31-10-2002.
the LAO has passed an award on 02-12-2002 and the award has been approved on 16-12-2002.
The LAO has fixed compensation of Rs.4,36,000/- in respect of dry lands.
As there are disputes with regard to title the LAO has sent reference to the Court and has deposited sum of Rs.15,53,157/-.
The said amount has been kept in Karnataka Bank CCC Extension Counter, Bangalore.

sentences.text: After receipt of reference, this court has registered the case and issued notice to both parties.
The claimants and respondents have entered appearance through their counsels.

4. Claimant No.1 Sri. Patalappa has filed claim statement, stating that lands in question is the ancestral property situated at Sonnehalli village, Kengeri Hobli, Bangalore South Taluk, measuring 2 acres 24 guntas in Sy.No.24/2.
All the records stands in his name.
The claimant No.2 does not have any right, title or interest over the lands in question.
With reference to the claim of Sridhara Murthy this claimant submits that he is not at all his son.
He is no way connected with the claimant's family.
Suit filed by Sri. Sridhar Murthy in O.S.No.2559/1997 for partition on the file of the Court of Addl. City Civil Judge, Bangalore has already been dismissed for default.

The 2nd claimant is not entitled to any share in the lands in question much less 1/7th share as he is neither a member of the family nor he has acquired any right in L.A.C. No.140/2003 his individual capacity.
Hence prayed to reject the claim of the claimant No.2 Sri. Sridhar Murthy and to pass orders to release the entire amount.

5. Claimant No.2, Sridhar Murthy has filed claim statement stating that the said property is the joint family property of the family headed by the first claimant herein and he has filed a suit for partition and separate possession in O.S. No.2559/1997 on the file of this Hon'ble Court.

The suit came to be dismissed for non-prosecution and he has filed a petition for restoration of the same in Misc. No.
208/2004 and the same is pending before this Hon'ble Court.
His share in the properties belonging to the joint family has not yet been determined.
Hence prayed to determine his share before disbursement.
6. The respondents have not filed objections to the claim statements filed by the above claimants.
In order to prove their case, the claimant No.1, 2 and 1(a) is examined as PW.1, PW.2 and PW.3.
Documents got marked at Ex.P.1 to 15(a).
The respondents have not adduced oral evidence.
8. Heard the arguments.

9. The following points that would arise for my consideration are:
1. Which of the claimants are entitled for compensation ?
2. What order or award?
10.

My findings on the above points are as under:
Point No.1: As per discussion Point No.2: As per discussion, for the following:
REASONS .11. POINT No.1:
The claimant No.1 has been examined himself as PW.1.

He has stated that his land is acquired for the purpose of Sir M Vishweshwaraiah )Patalappa vs ) The Addl.Land Acquisition Officer on 1 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101690130/

sentences.text: Nagara layout.
It is stated that claimant No.2 has filed O.S.No.2599/1997 claiming 1/7th share before the Addl. City Civil Judge, Bangalore and the said suit has been dismissed L.A.C. No.140/2003 for default.
Subsequently he filed Misc. No.208/2004 which is pending.
Pw.1 has stated that claimant No.2 is no way connected with this family and so the claimant No.2 is not entitled any share in the properties.
12. To corroborate the contention he has produced Genealogical tree as per Ex.P1.
From the genealogical tree it is seen that name of claimant No.2 is not mentioned.
Ex.P2 is a confirmation letter confirming the photograph and signature of claimant No.1.

Ex.P3 is RTC extract in respect of Sy.No.24/2 from the RTC the name of claimant No.1 is mentioned in column No.9, in column No.11 it is mentioned as ASLR MPR 139/88-89 taluk MPR-78/88-89 ADRCR No.79/88-89 proof signed by Tashildar, Bangalore South Taluk.
Ex.P4 is the Mutation extract in respect of MR 139.
it is seen that claimant has got Sy.No.24/2 measuring 2 acres and 24 guntas along with other properties in partition effected in the year 05-05-1960.
Ex.P5 is a tax paid receipt.
Ex.P6 is no due certificate issued by Village Accountant.
Ex.P7 is Nil Encumbrance Certificate for the period from 1- 06-1989 to 15-11-2002 in respect of Sy.No.24/2 measuring 2 L.A.C. No.140/2003 acres and 24 guntas.
Ex.P8 is no tenancy certificate issued by Tahsildar Bangalore South.
Ex . P9
is the Registration partition deed dated 05-05-1960.
From the partition deed it is seen that B schedule property has fallen to the share of claimant No.1.
In the deed it is mentioned that Sy.No.24/2 present Sy.No.27
totally
measures 5 acres and 2 guntas

. Pw.1 has got 2 acres and 24 guntas in the said Sy.No.
13. During the cross-examination he has stated that acquired land is Ancestral property.
It is elicited that claimant No.2 has filed suit for partition and the said case is pending.
Pw.1 has denied that claimant No.2 is entitled for compensation.
14. Claimant No.2 has been examined as Pw.2.
He has stated that he is also entitled for compensation along with his father.
It is stated that first claimant claimed that he is alone owner of the property and has denied his right so he filed O.S.No.2599/1997 against the first claimant which is pending for adjudication.

In support of his contention he has produced Ex.P10 is ESI card were in the particulars the name of the members of family is mentioned and the signature of L.A.C.
No.140/2003 Patalappa is found and the name of claimant No.2 is mentioned.
Ex.P3 is the birth certificate of claimant No.2, the name of the mother is mentioned as Bailamma W/o Patalappa.
Ex.P12 is a death certificate of Bailamma and husband name is mentioned as Patalappa.
Ex.P13 is SSLC marks card of Pw.2 and the father name is mentioned as Patalappa.
Ex.P5 is a Misc.Petition No.208/2004 seeking for restoration of O.S.No.2599/1997.
The discussion with regard to Ex.P10 to P14 would not arise as subsequently judgment has been passed in O.S.No.2599/1997.
From the order sheet dated 10-08-2009 it is seen that Pw.2 was not present.
The first claimant not present.
Evidence of Pw.2 has been closed.

4 15.
During the pendency of the case claimant No.1 has expired and his LR's was brought on record.

Claimant 1(a) Sri. Chandrashekhara P. has been examined as Pw.3 and he has stated that the second claimant is not entitled to any share in the compensation deposited as the suit in O.S.No.2599/1997 filed by the second claimant for partition against them and his father has been dismissed on 01-02- 2012.
Ex.P15 is judgment in the said suit.
From the L.A.C. No.140/2003 judgment it is seen that claimant No.2 is the plaintiff and the claimant No.1 and children are the defendants in the said suit.
The first issue in the said suit is whether the plaintiff proves that he is the youngest son of the first defendant and Bailamma?
The said issue has been answered in the Negative.
The suit has been dismissed.
The records discloses that claimant No.2 had filed RFA No.525/2012 and it is pending.
16. The oral and the documentary evidence clearly discloses that acquired property is the ancestral property of claimant No.1.
Claimant No.2 had failed to prove that he is son of claimant No.1.
Claimant No.1 has expired during pendency of the case.
As land has been acquired, his legal heirs is entitled for compensation amount.
Accordingly point No. 1 is answered.

.16. Point No.2: In view of my findings on points 1, proceed to pass the following.
 L.A.C. No.140/2003  OR D E R
The reference made by the respondent No.1/Addl. LAO under Sections 30 and 31(2) of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 is hereby allowed.
The LR's of claimant No.1 are  entitled to compensation to extent of guntas of Sonnehalli village, Kengeri Hobli, Bengaluru South Taluk.
It is open for claimant No.2 to seek for modification of the order if he succeeds in R.F.A.No.525/12.
At the time of receiving the compensation, LRs of claimant No.1 shall have to execute indemnity bond undertaking to refund amount if claimant No.2 succeeds in R.F.A. Draw award accordingly.
